headline: Health: Giorgetti confirms 6 billion more but warns about debt | Without control, one suffers
summary: Economy Minister Giorgetti confirmed an increase of €6 billion for healthcare, bringing total resources higher, and warned about the need to control debt.
why: Italy carries one of the euro area's highest public debt loads, so additional spending and debt warnings affect its government bonds and fiscal outlook.

original_headline: Sanità Giorgetti conferma 6 miliardi in più ma avverte sul debito | Senza controllo si subisce
